info.headline: Notify NYC - DOT Alternate Side Parking & DSNY Collection Services Suspension - 10/12
info.description:
Notification issued 10-11-2026 at 11:16 AM.
Alternate side parking and trash/recycling/composting collection services will be suspended citywide on Monday, 10/12 for Columbus Day/Italian Heritage Day/Indigenous People's Day by the New York City Department of Sanitation and the New York City Department of Transportation.
For more information, visit https://portal.311.nyc.gov or call 3-1-1.
